name: @rateloop/nextjs
description: Isolated tokenless RateLoop web app and v1 agent API

scripts.build: node scripts/check-identity-deployment.mjs && node scripts/check-tokenless-production-readiness.mjs && node scripts/migrate-hosted-database.mjs && node ../../scripts/with-workspace-dist-lock.mjs "yarn build:workspace-deps && rm -rf .next && rm -f node_modules/@rateloop/nextjs ../agents/node_modules/@rateloop/agents ../contracts/node_modules/@rateloop/contracts ../foundry/node_modules/@rateloop/foundry ../keeper/node_modules/@rateloop/keeper ../node-utils/node_modules/@rateloop/node-utils ../ponder/node_modules/@rateloop/ponder ../sdk/node_modules/@rateloop/sdk && next build --turbopack"
scripts.build:workspace-deps: yarn workspace @rateloop/node-utils build && yarn workspace @rateloop/contracts build && yarn workspace @rateloop/sdk build
scripts.check-types: node ../../scripts/with-workspace-dist-lock.mjs "yarn build:workspace-deps && rm -rf .next && next typegen && tsc --noEmit --incremental"
scripts.db:generate:
node -e "console.error('db:generate is disabled in this package.

Migrations under drizzle/ are hand-authored and drizzle-kit snapshots are intentionally absent from drizzle/meta/. With no snapshot to diff against, drizzle-kit generate treats the database as empty: it emits a CREATE-everything migration that can never apply to a migrated database, and it rewrites drizzle/meta/_journal.json, whose hashes are verified at deploy time by scripts/migrate-hosted-database.mjs.

To add a migration: write drizzle/NNNN_name.sql by hand, append a matching entry to drizzle/meta/_journal.json, then run yarn workspace @rateloop/nextjs test to check lib/db/migrationJournal.test.ts.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.db:push:
node -e "console.error('db:push is disabled in this package.

lib/db/schema.ts maps 66 tables, but the migrations in drizzle/ create 219. drizzle-kit push diffs the database against the schema and would drop the 153 unmapped tables (plus their CHECK constraints), destroying a migrated database.

Use yarn workspace @rateloop/nextjs db:migrate to apply the checked-in migrations instead.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.e2e: node ../../scripts/with-workspace-dist-lock.mjs "yarn build:workspace-deps && yarn e2e:prepare && playwright test"
scripts.e2e:hosted:unit: node --import tsx --test e2e/hosted-auth/*.test.ts e2e/hosted/hostedMcp.test.ts && node --test e2e/hosted/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: node ../../scripts/with-workspace-dist-lock.mjs "yarn build:workspace-deps && node ../../scripts/run-node-tests.mjs app components config lib utils scripts"
